comment.body:
Thanks for the error details. To distinguish the settings-sync failure tracked in #50795 from a separate process/clipboard failure:

1. State the affected PowerToys version and the action immediately before the error (enable MWB, open Settings, New key, connect, or Use Service).
2. Reproduce once, comment `/bugreport`, and attach the newly generated ZIP immediately afterward.

Please do not include pairing keys or device identities in screenshots.
